From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>, ops-lead@acmeanalytics.com
Cc: support@acmeanalytics.com
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Incident recap and initial action items — 2027-03-01 latency spike

Team,

Summary (short): On 2027-03-01 between 08:45–09:30 PT we observed a service-wide tail-latency spike for the hosted text-generation API that affected ~6% of customer requests (p95→p99 jump, sustained for ~45 mins). Root cause: a regression in our KV-cache parallelization introduced in rollout r2027.02.28 that caused disproportionate lock contention under a particular prefix distribution.

Impact:
- Customer-visible latency increase (p95 from 60ms→320ms; p99 from 180ms→1.2s)
- 14 affected accounts flagged; Acme Analytics reported elevated error rates during heavy batch requests
- No data exfiltration or model corruption detected

Immediate mitigation performed (timeline highlights):
- 08:50 PT: Canary alert; autoscaler held but individual nodes experiencing slow token emission
- 08:58 PT: Rolled back r2027.02.28 to r2027.02.24 on hosted pool A (partial rollback) — latency reduced for ~70% of affected traffic
- 09:12 PT: Full rollback across hosted pools; traffic normalized by 09:30 PT

Root cause analysis (preliminary):
- New parallel KV-cache code guarded by a coarse-grained mutex; under certain prefix skews, lock queuing produced long tail latency. Reproducer exists in stress test.

Open action items (owners / ETA):
- Marissa: Deliver alternate lock strategy (per-shard locking + backoff) and validated regression test by 2027-03-10; see canary plan attached (canary-runbook.md).
- Priya: Produce 1-page exec summary for QBR and compile customer impact metrics (top 5 customers, minutes impacted) by 2027-03-05.
- Ben: Coordinate finance/CS conversation re: goodwill credit for impacted accounts; proposal by 2027-03-07.
- SRE: Add a KV contention metric and alert; owner: (assigned in tracker) by 2027-03-08.

Attachments: incident-digest.pdf (full timeline + logs excerpt), canary-runbook.md (draft), sla-heatmap.csv (impact mapping).

I'll take point on the exec one-pager and attach the version for review by EOD Friday. Please flag any missing asks.

Thanks,

Priya Natarajan
Head of Reliability Programs
Redwood Inference
